name: Fire Dragon
description: A great fire dragon, its scales glowing ember-red as it fills the dark with smoke and heat.

name: Vault Brazier
description: A bronze brazier whose low flame keeps the old vault from complete darkness.

name: Sealed Letter
description: A folded letter sealed with dark red wax; its recipient has been scratched away.

name: Bloodright Banner
description: A faded crimson banner carrying the mark of the old Bloodright line.
